target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures address the accounting treatment of Held-to-Maturity (HTM) securities, specifically that they are accounted for at amortized cost and excluded from the fair value hierarchy. gs_2023_8_D214 also provides the hypothetical fair value hierarchy classification (Level 1/2), which gs_2024_8_D197 also includes. They share the specific topic of HTM accounting policy and hypothetical valuation hierarchy.

Both disclosures detail the composition of the Held-to-Maturity security portfolio. gs_2023_8_D214 specifies that government obligations are primarily U.S. government obligations and real estate-backed securities are residential. gs_2024_8_D198 provides the same compositional breakdown (US Gov, Agency MBS, Residential Real Estate). They share the specific topic of HTM portfolio composition.
